messages.content: I want to finish the Kauai arrangements today. First, the resort confirmation says partial ocean view even though we reserved an oceanfront king. Please resolve that before booking the spa or transportation.

I checked the reservation record. The confirmation header says Oceanfront King with Private Lanai, but the room-details field does say partial ocean view. I’ll ask the resort to confirm the actual assigned category, whether this is only an internal description, and whether correcting it changes the $7,873.61 estimate.
Also separate the lodging from parking. I need a clean comparison between keeping a car all eight nights and renting one only for sightseeing days.

The resort has clarified both points. The partial-ocean wording was attached in error. Your reservation is for an Oceanfront King with Private Lanai, and the corrected confirmation will use that wording throughout. There is no rate increase. They also confirmed that the earlier $7,873.61 estimate included $320 of projected valet parking, not a prepaid lodging charge. The fixed room, tax, and mandatory-fee total is $7,553.61; parking is $40 for each night a car is kept at the resort.
Good. Have them issue the corrected confirmation. Now show me the transportation choices with every material charge included.

The corrected confirmation has been issued at $7,553.61 before any parking. The $899.20 deposit and October 10 cancellation deadline are unchanged.

For an airport rental from October 24 through November 1, the compact-SUV quote is $618 including taxes and airport fees. Eight nights of valet parking add $320, and estimated fuel is $85, for $1,023 total.

For a shorter rental, airport transfers are $120 each way for two adults. A compact SUV collected near Poipu Tuesday morning, October 27, and returned Friday morning, October 30, is $312 including taxes. Three parking nights add $120 and estimated fuel is $50. That option totals $722, including both airport transfers.
Does the local rental office provide transportation from the resort, and are its hours workable on Friday?

Yes. The rental company provides complimentary pickup from Ko'a Kea with at least two hours’ notice. The office opens at 8:00 a.m. Tuesday through Friday and closes at 5:00 p.m. Your proposed pickup is 9:00 a.m. Tuesday, and the Friday return can be at 9:00 a.m.; they will take you back to the resort afterward. The quote includes a second authorized driver but not collision coverage.
The shorter rental is enough. Before you reserve it, check whether changing to Wednesday through Friday would materially reduce the price. We only need the car for Waimea Canyon and one flexible day.

A Wednesday, October 28 pickup conflicts with the spa availability that afternoon and reduces the rental by only $54. The two-day quote is $258; with two parking nights, fuel, and transfers, the transportation total would be about $618. Keeping Tuesday through Friday costs $104 more overall and gives you a full day before the spa plus flexibility if canyon weather is poor.
Keep Tuesday through Friday. Recheck the spa. Earlier we had two 11:00 openings, but I would rather have afternoon appointments if they can place us at the same time.

The spa no longer has two openings together at 11:00 a.m. on Wednesday, October 28. It can hold two simultaneous 80-minute treatments at 2:00 p.m.: one therapeutic massage and one customized facial. Each is $275. A 20% service charge adds $110, making the spa total $660. A $275 deposit is due at booking, with the remaining $385 payable after the treatments. Cancellation without penalty is allowed until 2:00 p.m. Hawaii time on October 27; after that, the full treatment prices are charged.
Can the treatment choices be changed later without losing the appointment times?

Yes. Either treatment may be changed to another 80-minute service at least 24 hours beforehand, subject to therapist availability. If the replacement costs more, you pay the difference; if it costs less, the final balance is reduced. The two 2:00 p.m. appointments remain together.
Book those two appointments with the deposit on the card ending 1842. Use my name for the massage and my spouse for the facial.

Both spa appointments are confirmed for Wednesday, October 28 at 2:00 p.m. The therapeutic massage is under Priya Nair and the customized facial is under your spouse’s name. A $275 deposit was charged to the card ending 1842. The estimated remaining balance, including service charge, is $385.
Now reserve the Tuesday-to-Friday SUV. Do not add the rental company’s collision coverage. Use the same card to guarantee it, but tell me whether anything is charged now.

The compact SUV is reserved for pickup near Poipu at 9:00 a.m. Tuesday, October 27 and return at 9:00 a.m. Friday, October 30. Resort pickup and return transportation are noted, and your spouse is included as the second authorized driver. The estimated rental total is $312 including taxes. The card ending 1842 guarantees the reservation, but no rental charge was collected today. Collision coverage was declined.
Complete the airport transfers too. I want the pickup times tied to the booked flights, with enough allowance for checked bags on arrival.

A private round-trip transfer is available for $240 total. On October 24, the driver will monitor United’s 12:27 p.m. arrival at LIH and meet you at baggage claim; the reservation includes up to 60 minutes of complimentary wait time after the flight reaches the gate. On November 1, pickup from Ko'a Kea will be at 10:00 a.m. for the 1:10 p.m. departure. The transfer is prepaid and refundable until 48 hours before each scheduled pickup.
Book it on the card ending 1842. Then give me the revised full vacation total and make clear what is paid versus still estimated.

The private transfers are confirmed, and $240 was charged to the card ending 1842.

The revised vacation total is $10,221.61 before meals, optional activities, and other incidentals. That consists of $1,286 airfare, $7,553.61 lodging, $660 for the two spa treatments, $240 for airport transfers, $312 for the three-day SUV, $120 for three nights of resort parking, and $50 estimated fuel.

Already charged or deposited: $1,286 airfare, the resort’s $899.20 deposit, the $275 spa deposit, and $240 for transfers, totaling $2,700.20. The remaining projected amount is $7,521.41: $6,654.41 toward the resort, $385 at the spa, $312 for the rental, $120 parking, and about $50 fuel.

The corrected resort confirmation now consistently states Oceanfront King with Private Lanai at the unchanged lodging total of $7,553.61 before parking. The spa, local rental, and both airport transfers are confirmed. The full-stay airport rental was not booked.
